# Rest of World

> Rest of World is a nonprofit newsroom reporting on technology's impact across emerging markets, China, Africa, and the Global South with perspectives often missing from Western tech coverage.

Rest of World combines investigative journalism with regional expertise to cover AI ethics, geopolitics, digital infrastructure, and tech policy in underrepresented parts of the world. The publication features reporting from journalists embedded across Africa, China, India, the Middle East, and other regions.

## Key Topics

- China tech
- Emerging markets
- AI ethics
- Geopolitics
- Digital infrastructure
- Global tech reporting
- Non-Western perspectives
- Tech policy
- Artificial intelligence
- International tech
- Nonprofit journalism
- Local journalists
- East Africa
- India tech
- US-China competition

## Core Organization

- [Rest of World - Reporting Global Tech Stories](https://restofworld.org): Homepage for global nonprofit covering technology impact beyond Western markets
- [About us - Rest of World](https://restofworld.org/about): Mission and editorial vision of Rest of World nonprofit journalism organization

## Regional Coverage Hubs

- [China - Rest of World](https://restofworld.org/region/china): Regional coverage hub for China tech including AI startups and US-China competition
- [Africa - Rest of World](https://restofworld.org/region/africa): Regional coverage hub for African technology innovation and digital connectivity

- [Latest - Rest of World](https://restofworld.org/latest): Latest tech articles covering AI, China, and emerging markets from global reporters
